title: Awesome tour!
text: We had an amazing tour of the Gothic Quarter with Andrew. He is an excellent story teller, this tour was a highlight of our stay in Barcelona. He also gave us very good tips where to eat which we used.
author: lloyd255100

title: Fantastic Tour!
text: Our guide Pablo was terrific . He told us so much information that of course we didn't know and it was fascinating we walked the gothic area and El Borne. A memorable tour with a memorable guide, don't miss this one folks
author: Michele_R

title: Exceptional experience of the Barcelona history
text: We only just arrived on time as we was on a cruise ship and it was a 25 minute walk to the meeting point only a suggestion for persons on cruises a map from the port would be helpful
author: AnneMarie_F

title: Great Tour with Jordan
text:
I have done a lot of Sandeman's walking tour, yet rarely written a review so it speaks for itself. We had a great time getting to know the city with Jordan. He is extremely passionate with a penchant for storytelling and kept it interesting and entertaining.
Highly recommend!!
author: akshaysareen

title: Free tour with Pedro
text: Pedrito is a great guy, we did the tour with him, and he explains everything in a great way, it is very much worth it and you can feel that he is very prepared to guide one through the history of Barcelona
author: alejandropL616FS

title: Excellent tour
text: Excellent visit with the guide PEDRO. Every minute of the tour was well spent. In a short time, he explained the history of this beautiful city in great detail. 100% recommended.
author: ArielG1272

title: Excellent tour!
text:
This was my first experience of a tour with Sandemans and would absolutely book again.

My guide Andy was incredibly knowledgeable and passionate and Barcelona. I felt like I learnt a lot while at the same time had a lot of fun. Would 100% recommend this tour.
author: X2602MUchriss

title: Sandeman Walking tour
text: Jordan is a great guide passionate about history, storytelling, and themes. Great introduction of Barcelona. Would highly recommend!
author: SMDoc_101

title: Free Barcelona Walking Tour
text: We had a great tour with Andrew on Sunday.  You could tell he has a passion for this area’s history.  Great amount of information and fun while walking around the area.  I’ve done tours with this company since 2011 and never been disappointed! Highly recommend!
author: briannah551

title: Sandlemans Walking Tour of Barcelona
text: Our guide Pablo was amazing and super passionate about Barcelona! He provided a lot of helpful tips and was very knowledgeable about the history of the city. Pablo used humor and storytelling to keep us engaged as we visited historical sites. I would highly recommend!
author: 978kristenf
